title: Manufacturer Copay Card Annual Maximum for High-Deductible Plans — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The annual maximum with which a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs opens a new benefit period follows the linked plan and the deductible the plan applied on the patient's paid claims dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

| Linked plan (Prescription Insurance on File) | Deductible applied on paid claims in the last 12 whole months | Annual maximum |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | $2000.00 or more | $12000.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | less than $2000.00 | $10800.00 |
| Any other plan | any amount | the program's annual benefit maximum |

The plan is the class of the coverage record the card is linked to; the deductible is the deductible amounts on the patient's paid claims dated fewer than 12 whole months before today, added together.

**Hypothetical patients.** Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan with $2400.00 of deductible: $12000.00. Same plan with $1500.00: $10800.00. Commercial Copay Plan: the program's annual benefit maximum.
